scripts.health-check: npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.check:all: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run guard:static && npm run build && npm run smoke:routes && npm run smoke:seo && npm run smoke:canonical-routes && npm run perf:budget
scripts.check:release: npm run check:all && npm run test:e2e:core
scripts.check:release:production: npm run check:release && npm run smoke:reader:production
scripts.build:e2e: cross-env NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-playwright node scripts/clean-next-artifacts.mjs && cross-env NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-playwright next build
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:e2e && npm run playwright:test
scripts.test:e2e:core: npm run build:e2e && cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_USE_PREBUILT=1 PLAYWRIGHT_WORKERS=1 playwright test tests/e2e/adult-toggle.spec.ts tests/e2e/content-mode.spec.ts tests/e2e/reader-layout.spec.ts tests/e2e/mobile-layout.spec.ts tests/e2e/analytics-tracking.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:comments: npm run build:e2e && cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_USE_PREBUILT=1 playwright test tests/e2e/auth-required.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:funnel: npm run build:e2e && cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_USE_PREBUILT=1 playwright test tests/e2e/public-reading-funnel.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:browser:headed: npm run build:e2e && cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_USE_PREBUILT=1 playwright test --headed
scripts.test:e2e:library: npm run build:e2e && cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_USE_PREBUILT=1 playwright test tests/e2e/library-reading-state-smoke.spec.ts tests/e2e/library-reading-state-regression.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:library:smoke: npm run build:e2e && cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_USE_PREBUILT=1 playwright test tests/e2e/library-reading-state-smoke.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:library:regression: npm run build:e2e && cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_USE_PREBUILT=1 playwright test tests/e2e/library-reading-state-regression.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:store: npm run build:e2e && cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_USE_PREBUILT=1 playwright test tests/e2e/store-routing.spec.ts
scripts.analyze: npm run clean:next && cross-env ANALYZE=true next build --no-lint
scripts.analyze:server: npm run clean:next && cross-env ANALYZE=true BUNDLE_ANALYZE=server next build --no-lint
scripts.analyze:browser: npm run clean:next && cross-env ANALYZE=true BUNDLE_ANALYZE=browser next build --no-lint
